## Shipyard

- Give each of the nine roles its own Markdown personality profile. The Chief of Staff starts with Elon Musk. Use `--personas` to list profiles or `--persona chief-of-staff:andy-grove` to switch. Create a personal profile with `--persona-create`, `--name`, and `--traits`. Codex and Claude Code share personal selections.
- In ask mode, the Chief of Staff gives the user 60 seconds to respond to a proposed replacement. A reply interrupts the timeout. After silence, the active coordinator can proceed with that handoff. On resume it checks queued replies before acting.
- Codex now selects `gpt-6.2-sol:medium` for balanced work and `gpt-6.2-astra:high` for deep work. The economy tier uses `gpt-6-luna:low`. Existing explicit model pins remain supported.

## Install or update

For a direct global installation, run `npx skills@latest add itamaker/skills --skill=shipyard -g`. To update an existing installation, run `npx skills@latest update`. Users of the Claude Code marketplace plugin can update the marketplace and the installed `itamaker-skills@itamaker` plugin.

For previously installed native roles, update the skill and rerun its native setup to load the new profile instructions. Preview the changes first, apply them for the clients you use, and start a new session. See the [native setup guide](https://github.com/itamaker/skills/blob/v2.1.3/skills/dev/shipyard/references/clients.md).
